name: zennify-dma
description: Zennify Digital Maturity Assessment tooling: the skills, agents and connector that produce and audit DMA Insights surfaces.

plugins.name: dma-insights
plugins.description: The six DMA skills, the 47-agent roster with explicit tool allow-lists, two operator commands, submit/verdict/promote hooks and the remote DMA Insights MCP connector (33 tools). A lost connector binding — a continued session after a token reset included — is revived with mcp_raw.py revive rather than declared unrecoverable.
